subject: Procurement play: Hybrid approach for compliance tooling (Drata automation + TrustCenter marketplace)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@drata.com>, Viktor Novak <viktor@trustcenter.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement ask: consolidated renewal quote + connector inventory

Hi Alicia, Viktor,

Thanks for the recent demos — both Drata and TrustCenter gave good coverage on automation and marketplace integrations. Acme Health is evaluating a hybrid approach: Drata for continuous evidence automation, and TrustCenter as the marketplace layer for third-party attestations and partner proofs.

To move procurement and legal forward we need a single consolidated quote that shows:
- Line items by product/module (automation, connectors, marketplace access)
- Per-seat/user or flat fee assumptions if any
- Add-on costs (e.g., MSA/SOC2 support, professional services for connector onboarding)
- Recommended PO cadence (quarterly vs annual) and suggested renewal windows (we prefer calendar Q4)

Attached is our current coverage spreadsheet so you can map to what we already have (redwood_current_coverage.xlsx). Please include estimated implementation lead times for each connector and a rough timeline for evidence handoff.

Internal folks: Marcus/Kimberly — can you confirm the list of integrations we care about (SSO, GCS logs, CI system, DB snapshots) so vendors can call out specific connector work?

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Head of Vendor Strategy, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_current_coverage.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)

From: Viktor Novak <viktor@trustcenter.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@drata.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement ask: consolidated renewal quote + connector inventory

Hi Naomi (and team),

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Attaching a TrustCenter proposal that lays out two paths:
1) Marketplace-first: full TrustCenter + connector management (best for partner attestations, higher marketplace fees)
2) Passthrough model: limited TrustCenter seat license plus marketplace-only fees; rely on Drata for automation and evidence collection

I attached trustcenter_proposal_q2-q4.pdf which has pricing ranges and implementation estimates. For the passthrough model we estimate ~3–4 weeks per third-party connector to validate and onboard (depending on partner cooperation).

Quick notes:
- If you centralize onboarding through TrustCenter we can provide automated attestations for partners, but expect some duplicate evidence until Drata is fully integrated.
- We can do a staged onboarding: 4 connectors in Q2, remaining in Q3, with a fallback in Q4.

Open to a joint call with Alicia to align timelines and avoid overlap.

Best,
Viktor Novak
Director, Partner Solutions | TrustCenter
viktor@trustcenter.com

Attachment: trustcenter_proposal_q2-q4.pdf (PDF, 215KB)

- Cloud logs: GCS Stackdriver (medium)

Subject: Mutual action plan + next steps (DocuSign link included)

Hi Procurement,

Following vendor responses, our recommended path is a hybrid procurement: commit to Drata for automation (annual term) and contract TrustCenter on a marketplace passthrough with quarterly invoicing for partner attestations. Rationale: minimizes duplicate evidence efforts while preserving partner-proofing.

Requested next steps:
- Procurement: confirm preferred billing cadence and any PO terms by Tue 17 Feb
- Kimberly: draft a short SOW for PS onboarding of Okta and CircleCI connectors (targeted 6-week delivery) — attach to DocuSign for sign-off
- Vendors (Alicia/Viktor): return final line-item quote with implementation dates in one consolidated PDF (we prefer a single attachment we can send to legal)

I've prepared a mutual action plan and put it in the DocuSign envelope here: https://app.docusign.com/RED-Procure/ACQ78. Please acknowledge and route to legal as appropriate.

Thanks all — aiming to have signed orders and kickoff by the end of March.

Naomi
